title: All Items
description: A Minecraft plugin that tracks your progress in collecting every obtainable item in survival mode. Perfect for completionists and collectors!
body:
### Automatic Item Tracking

Automatically detects when you collect new items through crafting or picking up
Real-time progress notifications with percentage completion
Celebratory broadcast when a player collects all items

### Interactive GUI

Beautiful, paginated inventory interface to browse all items
Visual indicators showing collected vs missing items
Built-in search functionality to quickly find specific items

### Commands

- **/allitems gui** - Opens the interactive item browser
- **/allitems search <term>** - Search for specific items
- **/allitems progress** - Check your collection progress
- **/allitems missing** - View all items you haven't collected yet
- **/allitems top** - See the server leaderboard
- **/allitems reset** - Reset your progress (start over)

Smart Item Filtering
The plugin only tracks items that are legitimately obtainable in survival mode, automatically excluding:

Creative-only blocks (Barrier, Command blocks, Structure blocks ...)
Unobtainable items (Bedrock, End Portal Frames, Spawners ...)
Technical blocks (Fire, Water, Lava, Farmland ...)
Debug items and spawn eggs
Other non-survival items
